itemDispositions.reasoning: Opened docs/guides/per-worktree-dev.md:14-29 and :64-109: the command table and multi-lane workflow expose only unqualified worktree:status. scripts/worktree-db.sh:14-20 and :1536-1565 implement distinct --all and --lanes modes, including --base and mutual-exclusion rules. The omission hides the Postgres-free cross-lane Git-progress dashboard precisely where the guide teaches parallel-lane coordination.

Opened package.json:60-63 and :116-134, harness.controls.json:60-80, :1175-1207, :1608-1616, and :1686-1722, plus scripts/harness/generated-surfaces.ts:58-83 and :99-150. Although writer commands use bare, :generate, and :refresh forms, the manifest explicitly records each invocation and checkScript and the loader normalizes them into refreshScript/checkScript roles. No ambiguity or broken discovery follows; renaming them would create broad package, documentation, and hook churn for cosmetic consistency.

Inventoried packages/client/src/components/character-create and opened its state, context, validation, submission projection, page composition, and the module-doc charter. The directory has 21 production files and no MODULE.md. wizard-state.ts:229-275 owns class-change rewind/spell clearing and background-change equipment-reset invariants; wizard-validation.ts:46-74 gates conditional steps; create-character-input.ts:58-91 is the transport boundary. docs/module-docs.md:24-30 calls for local orientation on exactly this kind of stateful cross-file feature.

Opened docs/README.md:13-16 and :29-31, which call ai-harness.md the single-source inventory of every guide and say its Guides table indexes them all. docs/ai-harness.md:359-396 inventories the operator and adoption ratchet guides but not lint-ratchet-merges.md or lint-ratchet-reference.md. Both omitted files are substantive, deliberately separate guides. scripts/drift-ai/harness-freshness.ts:134-151 detects file-wide reference absence but does not enforce inventory-table membership.

Opened docs/guides/lint-message-evals.md:46-55, scripts/lint-message-eval.ts:28-54, scripts/lint-message-eval/trace.ts:61-119, scripts/lint-message-eval/evaluator.ts:127-156, and the committed pilot trace and report. Capture deliberately depends on separate fresh sessions, randomized arm order, complete-source responses, and human-recorded caveats; a recorder cannot enforce the important independence controls. The existing CLI validates and grades completed traces, and no recurring capture population or transcription failure supports productizing this one-off manual research protocol. Authored leaf 176 already owns the sharp provenance-integrity defect.

Opened CLIENT-CLUSTER-PLAN.md and checked all three refusals against the current client. CQ25-190 remains supported by VttSurface ownership in components/vtt/MODULE.md:15-18 and behaviorally different map/combat callers. CQ25-193 remains supported by the single SheetSharedProps declaration and derived desktop/mobile shapes without effect-maintained context. CQ25-187 remains supported by heterogeneous Input, Select, Textarea, and Checkbox populations. The cut merely restates three live prior-pack refusals and supplies no reason to overturn them.

Opened eslint-rules/structured-logging.js, its RuleTester suite, eslint-config/package-boundary-configs.js, and the generated harness inventory. The implementation owns three policies, but its published description/principle and authoritative generated inventory describe only static messages and direct console calls. A separate ImportDeclaration visitor rejects createScriptLogger imports outside seed/script paths, leaving the third enforced policy undocumented.

Opened eslint-config/max-lines-exceptions.baseline.json, scripts/max-lines-exceptions-core.ts, and eslint-config/max-lines-exceptions-codec.js. Most reasons state durable current justifications, but the SRD router entry appends +1/+4 implementation deltas and the rest-service entry appends ux-audit change history. The codec requires only a nonblank string and normalization preserves it verbatim, so these fields accumulate changelog prose instead of remaining current exception rationales.

Opened smoke-subject-headers.ts, fixture-shell-dependencies.ts, path-policy-query-core.ts, smoke-test-files.ts, prior H14/CQ25-119, and authored leaves 151/152. H14 centralized smoke-file naming and path normalization, but subject syntax is still parsed independently by the generator and fixture precondition, while exact/trailing-slash matching is hand-copied between selection and fixture coverage. The fixture copy claims parity with the selector but shares neither implementation nor a parity guard.

Opened trpc-shared-schema-imports.ts, trpc-shared-schema-writes.ts, structured-logging-fix-transforms.ts, structured-logging-fix.ts, expand-barrel/run.ts, and authored leaf 149. Structured-logging and expand-barrel call sortImportBlocks while constructing plans, then writeOrPreviewFiles repeats the same full-source sorter; real writes subsequently invoke ESLint simple-import-sort. The first repeated parse/rewrite is redundant, while the custom-versus-ESLint split leaves preview/fallback and successful writes without one declared normalization owner.

promotionCandidates.title: Give the client character-creation wizard a local orientation contract

evidence.measurement: 21 production files and no MODULE.md (`find /workspace/packages/client/src/components/character-create -type f ! -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.test.tsx' | wc -l`)
evidence.note: This is a large multi-step feature directory without the repository's local orientation document.
The charter requires MODULE docs for large feature directories and surfaces hiding non-obvious state or cross-file flow.
The reducer owns cross-step invariants: class changes rewind progress and clear spells, while background changes clear equipment.
Step advancement is a keyed validation graph, including exact class-dependent spell counts.
A separate projection converts wizard state into the shared mutation contract and intentionally leaves universal proficiencies to the server.
The page composes nine step components plus state, navigation, and submission seams.

promotionCandidates.problem: A contributor entering this 21-file wizard has no local map of state ownership, conditional-step behavior, cross-step reset invariants, validation, or the client-to-server projection boundary. Those contracts are spread across reducer comments and implementation files despite meeting the repository's explicit MODULE threshold.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Add character-create/MODULE.md covering provider/reducer ownership, step composition, conditional spell navigation, reset invariants, validation and buildCreateInput boundaries, and focused test seams; regenerate MODULE-INDEX.md.

promotionCandidates.title: The claimed complete guide map omits two deliberate lint-ratchet guides

evidence.note: The docs landing page calls ai-harness.md the authoritative single-source inventory of every guide.
It explicitly claims the ai-harness Guides table indexes all task recipes.
The guide inventory names lint-ratchet.md and lint-ratchet-adoption.md but has no entries for the merge runbook or internals reference.
This is a substantive operator runbook for merge drivers, truth-up hooks, recovery, and portable merge handling.
This is a substantive internals reference covering the kernel, registry, CI, metrics, identity, parsers, and rollout.

evidence.measurement: Two guide files lack canonical docs/guides references in ai-harness.md (`comm -23 <(find /workspace/docs/guides -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' -printf 'docs/guides/%f\n' | sort) <(rg -o 'docs/guides/[a-z0-9-]+\.md' /workspace/docs/ai-harness.md | sort -u)`): lint-ratchet-merges.md and lint-ratchet-reference.md
evidence.note: The omission is exactly the two intentionally separated ratchet guides.
The freshness check reports files with no full-path reference anywhere in ai-harness.md but does not enforce inventory-table membership.

promotionCandidates.problem: The docs front door promises a complete, single-source guide map, yet two operationally distinct lint-ratchet guides are absent. Readers cannot discover merge recovery or the internals reference by task, and the freshness sensor checks file-wide references rather than inventory membership.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Add dedicated inventory rows for the merge runbook and internals reference, preserving their distinct audiences. Tighten or clarify the freshness contract so a stray reference cannot satisfy a claim that the Guides table indexes every guide.

evidence.note: The rule's published description and principle describe static-message and direct-console policy only.

evidence.note: The generator owns subject tokenization plus repo-relative POSIX validation.
The fixture precondition declares its own smoke-subject header regex rather than consuming the generator parser.
The fixture precondition independently tokenizes smoke subjects with weaker validation.
Changed-mode selection defines exact-path and trailing-slash-prefix matching privately.

promotionCandidates.title: Codemod write plans normalize imports redundantly through three passes

evidence.note: The structured-logging transformer sorts import blocks while constructing its rewrite result.
Expand-barrel likewise sorts each plan before passing it to the shared writer.
The shared writer sorts every plan again and, for real writes, then launches ESLint's simple-import-sort rules.
sortImportBlocks reparses the full source with a fresh ts-morph Project and rewrites import ranges, so duplicate calls are substantive repeated work.

promotionCandidates.problem: Structured-logging and expand-barrel parse and rewrite imports at transformation time and immediately repeat the identical custom pass in writeOrPreviewFiles; successful real writes then apply another policy through ESLint. This wastes full-file parsing, obscures normalization ownership, and lets dry-run or fallback output differ from successful written output without an explicit contract.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Make the shared writer the sole owner of plan normalization and remove producer-side sortImportBlocks calls. Then document or characterize the remaining custom-sort/ESLint relationship so preview and write semantics have one deliberate contract.
